name: Reading The Word Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that reading and meditating on God's Word is essential for spiritual prosperity and success, as it guides believers to live according to His commands (Joshua 1:8). The Word of God serves as a lamp and light, providing clarity and understanding even to the simple (Psalms 119:105, 130). By hiding God's Word in the heart, believers are empowered to resist sin (Psalms 119:11), and through prayerful dependence, God opens their eyes to behold the wondrous truths contained within His law (Psalms 119:18). Avoiding ungodly counsel and instead delighting in Scripture leads to blessedness and godly living (Psalms 1:1).
